description: List countries and valid country/region filter codes for ourairports_search_airports and ourairports_search_runways, with airport counts excluding closed airports. Restrict to country for one country's regions; country and continent combine as AND. include_regions without a scope returns the entire region table, so prefer country for a one-country lookup. Unscoped and continent-only requests remain available.

continent.description: Restrict to one continent: AF (Africa), AN (Antarctica), AS (Asia), EU (Europe), NA (North America), OC (Oceania), SA (South America).

country.description: Country code from ourairports_list_countries (e.g. US). Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace is ignored. Literal empty string is unset; whitespace-only is invalid.

include_regions.description: When true, nest each country's ISO 3166-2 regions (with airport counts) under it. Off by default to keep the response compact.

name: ourairports_list_countries

countries.description: Countries present in the dataset, sorted by name.

items.description: A country present in the dataset, with its non-closed airport count and ISO code.

airportCount.description: Number of non-closed airports in the country.

code.description: Country code to pass as country to ourairports_search_airports or ourairports_search_runways.

continent.description: Two-letter continent code (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA), or null.

regions.description: Regions within the country with airport counts. Present only when include_regions is true.

items.description: A region within a country, with its non-closed airport count.

airportCount.description: Number of non-closed airports in the region.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_country`: The country code is absent from the bundled country table. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the country and/or continent filters matched no countries.

title: List Countries
